knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A completed cycle does not prove clean items. Residue means hold and reprocess.
Nested items block water and product from reaching all surfaces.
Settings are set by the manufacturer and the site procedure, not changed by the cleaner.

practicalCriteria: Pre-removes soil and loads a mock rack without nesting.
Inspects every item after a simulated cycle.
Holds and reprocesses an item with simulated residue, and records the hold.
passRule: Load correct, every item inspected, and simulated residue held and reprocessed with a complete record. Observed by an assessor.
stopWorkCriteria: Item with residue released to service
Cycle or dosing changed from the approved setting
